MODEL_SPECS.principle: Exact mandated model identities prevent legacy smoke models from supporting headline claims.

aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: Every headline must derive from per-unit and transition rows.

charged_cost_recomputation.principle: All live inference, exact checks, persistence, and intervention costs must derive from raw receipts.

coobservation_and_dose_receipt.principle: Replay benefit must be separated from extra update exposure.

current_cost_and_success_rows.principle: Immediate benefit must charge model, solver, routing, and memory work.

duration_s.principle: Real flagship GGUF inference requires plausible monotonic wall time.

field_provenance.principle: Each headline must identify model receipts, exact rows, transitions, and reducer code.

frozen_chronology_and_arm_contract.principle: Freezing order, arms, dose, budgets, and support probes prevents outcome-driven design.

future_support_rows.principle: Endpoint gains are ineligible if future exact-satisfying behavior becomes less reachable.

gate_check_summary.principle: A blocked run must name the failed gate or live resource and observed value.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict must name current, retention, future-support, safety, and receipt outcomes with a terminal prefix.

inference_substrate.principle: The artifact must declare authenticated local llama.cpp GGUF inference plus exact Z3 evaluation.

live_model_and_gpu_receipts.principle: Process, model-file, GPU, timing, and output receipts prove fresh local inference occurred.

memory_transition_rows.principle: Each proposed write and committed state change must carry its exact witness and hashes.

per_unit_rows.principle: Every model, query, seed, arm, and condition needs a row for recomputation.

preconditions_checked.principle: GPU, model, runner, solver, and storage checks distinguish blocked execution from null learning.

prospective_csl_ready_score.principle: A binary headline is allowed only when benefit, safety, support, and receipt gates all pass.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The experiment must preserve protected orchestration files.

random_seed.principle: Fixed generation, order, and tie seeds make the prospective comparison repeatable.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final hash detects mutation of the terminal prospective record.

restart_and_rollback_receipts.principle: Continuous learning must persist and recover exactly across process and state failures.

retained_family_rows.principle: Current gains may not hide regression on earlier constraint families.

sample_size_and_power_contract.principle: Per-model query, domain, regime, and seed floors bound the strength of comparative claims.

status.principle: A terminal state distinguishes a completed prospective stream from cached setup output.

tests_run.principle: Named unit, lint, verifier, and E2E receipts show all paths were checked.

unsafe_write_and_use_ledger.principle: One invalid admission or reuse is load-bearing safety evidence.

upstream_gate_receipts.principle: Both reversible-controller and external-evidence gates must be independently recheckable.

verdict_class.principle: A closed class prevents circular, unsafe, blocked, or partial learning from becoming positive.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The compared memory policy is not ground truth; exact Z3 outcomes remain separate authority.

honest_verdict: blocked: current, retention, and future-support not evaluated; safety not promoted; receipts failed gpu_vram_contract
